title: 第三章 蠢蠢欲动的手第四章 天降碰瓷
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
跪在地上的少女，留着一头浅金色的长发，长相跟唐斩月有五六分的相似，但面色更苍白，姿态更柔弱，很容易便能激起别人的保护欲。
温晚意怯生生地抬眸，“姐姐，你和逸哥哥从小一起长大，他对你那么好，你都忘了吗？这次他也只是着急，气你无缘无故伤了我……”
“真是无缘无故吗？”唐斩月语气平淡地接了一句，随后对唐渊招招手，“我累了。”
唐渊啧了声，像是嫌弃，但人已经大步过来，从空间钮里取出两把柔软舒适的椅子，并排放一起。
他姿态优雅地坐下，翘着腿对唐斩月抬了抬下巴，“坐。”
唐斩月嘴角抽了抽，她爹现在好装啊。
椅子很大，她干脆整个人窝进去，找了个舒服的姿势靠着，而后才懒洋洋地睨了眼温晚意，“怎么不说话了？”
温晚意气得说不出来。
她刚跪下是为了展现柔弱，博同情，可现在唐斩月这么一搞，衬得她好像一个祈求主人原谅的奴仆！
温晚意低着头，眼底闪过一抹嫉恨，再抬头仍是一副泫然欲泣的可怜样，“姐姐，我知道你看不惯我，可我真没做过伤害你的事。”
“逸哥哥他们只是可怜我，想要多照顾我一点，大不了……”她咬着唇，艰难做出抉择，“大不了，我以后都不见他们，求姐姐不要再因为我为难他们。”
贺兰逸感动得不行，同时心中对唐斩月越发的不喜。
唐斩月挑眉，“你真的很会说话。短短几句便将我们放在了对立位上，还给我安了一个嚣张跋扈的人设。”
温晚意一愣，连忙摇头，“我不是那个意思……”
“不重要。”唐斩月弯了弯眼睛，“你没说错，我就是嚣张跋扈，随心所欲，谁让我难过，我就要让他难过一百倍，一千倍。”
她抬眼看向督星办的人，淡声道：“把她一起带走吧。”
督星办的人先是看了眼唐渊，见他点头，几人才过来把温晚意拉起来。
温晚意傻眼了，下意识找人求助，“唐叔叔！”
唐渊安抚的笑了笑，“只是协助调查而已，很快就能出来了。别担心，督星办的医疗水平应该比这里强一点。”
一句话不仅将温晚意堵了回去，连还没来得及开口的贺兰逸都张不开嘴。

唐渊生气了，他要给唐斩月出气。
今天他们必须被督星办带走，谁也拦不住。
病房很快就清净了。
唐渊偏头打量这个明显跟之前不太一样的女儿，“不做点什么的话，他们很快就会被人保出去。”
“没关系，游戏才刚刚开始呢。”唐斩月没想一杆子将人打死，那太无聊了。
打蛇要打七寸，报仇，自然也要从仇人最在乎的东西上下手。
而且知道这是她原本的世界后，她对贺兰逸也有了点印象，好像是小时候爸爸给她找的玩伴？
这十几年也不知道原主代替她怎么混的，竟然能被儿时玩伴联合外人欺负死。
啧，真窝囊。
而且听温晚意的意思，这里面似乎还有其他几个人的事？她有点期待了。
“走吧。”唐渊起身道，“我约了医生给你做全身检查。”
content_en:
The girl kneeling on the ground has long, light golden hair. She looks 50 or 60% similar to Tang Zhanyue, but her face is paler and her posture is more delicate. She can easily arouse the protective desire of others.
Wen Wanyi raised her eyes timidly, "Sister, you and Brother Yi grew up together. He was so good to you, have you forgotten? This time he was just anxious and angry that you hurt me for no reason..."
"Is it really for no reason?" Tang Zhanyue answered in a calm tone, and then waved to Tang Yuan, "I'm tired."
Tang Yuan clicked his tongue, as if he was disgusted, but he had already strode over, took out two soft and comfortable chairs from the space button, and placed them side by side.
He sat down gracefully, crossed his legs and raised his chin to Tang Zhanyue, "Sit."
The corner of Tang Zhanyue's mouth twitched, her father was so pretending now.
The chair was so big that she simply settled into it and found a comfortable position to lean on. Then she glanced lazily at Wen Wanyi and said, "Why don't you say anything?"
Wen Wanyi was too angry to speak.
She knelt down just now to show her weakness and win sympathy, but now Tang Zhanyue's behavior made her look like a slave begging for his master's forgiveness!
Wen Wanyi lowered her head, with a flash of jealousy in her eyes. When she raised her head, she still looked pitiful and on the verge of tears, "Sister, I know you can't stand me, but I've never done anything to hurt you."
"Brother Yi and the others just pity me and want to take care of me more. The worst case..." She bit her lip and made a difficult choice. "The worst case is that I will never see them again. Please don't embarrass them because of me."
He Lanyi was extremely moved, and at the same time, he became increasingly unhappy with Tang Zhanyue.
Tang Zhanyue raised his eyebrows, "You are really good at talking. In just a few sentences, you put us on opposite sides and gave me an arrogant and domineering persona."
Wen Wanyi was stunned and shook her head quickly, "I didn't mean that..."
"It's not important." Tang Zhanyue rolled his eyes, "You are right, I am arrogant and domineering and do whatever I want. Whoever makes me sad, I will make him sad a hundred times or a thousand times."
She raised her eyes to look at the person at the Governor's Office and said softly: "Take her away with you."
The people from the Star Supervision Office first glanced at Tang Yuan, and when they saw him nodding, a few people came over to pull Wen Wanyi up.
Wen Wanyi was dumbfounded and subconsciously looked for help, "Uncle Tang!"
Tang Yuan smiled reassuringly, "I'm just assisting in the investigation. I'll be out soon. Don't worry, the medical level at the Governor's Office should be better than here."
This sentence not only blocked Wen Wanyi's words, but also He Lanyi, who had not had time to speak, could not open his mouth.
Tang Yuan was angry and wanted to vent his anger on Tang Zhanyue.
Today they must be taken away by the Star Supervisor Office, and no one can stop them.
The ward was quickly cleared.
Tang Yuan tilted his head and looked at this daughter who was obviously different from before, "If we don't do something, they will be bailed out soon."
"It doesn't matter, the game has just begun." Tang Zhanyue didn't want to beat people to death with one shot, that would be too boring.
To hit a snake, you have to hit it seven inches. To take revenge, you must naturally start with what the enemy cares about most.
And knowing that this was her original world, she also had some impression of He Lanyi. It seemed like he was the playmate her father found for her when she was a child?
In the past ten years, I don’t know how the original owner managed to live in her place, and was bullied to death by her childhood friends and outsiders.
Tsk, what a coward.
And according to Wen Wanyi, it seems that there are several other people involved? She was looking forward to it.
"Let's go." Tang Yuan stood up and said, "I've made an appointment with the doctor to do a full body examination on you."
